episode_summary: In this episode, Kim Rittberg emphasizes the importance of short form video and AI in enhancing real estate agents' social media presence and personal branding. She provides actionable strategies for leveraging video content and AI tools to increase engagement, streamline content creation, and maintain client relationships. The discussion highlights the significance of being visible and active on social media to stay top of mind with clients.
